title: Math Rock
tagline: Odd meters, sharp guitars and a sense of engineering in the groove.
summary: Math rock often treats rhythm as a structure to be chiselled, not just a pulse to follow. With angular guitars, shifting patterns and intricate timing, it draws energy from prog, post-hardcore and jazz without sounding like a direct copy of any one of them. The style rewards closeness and repetition in equal measure.

pillars.name: Don Caballero
pillars.why: Don Caballero helped make the genre feel both technical and musical, placing precision inside a strong rock identity.

pillars.name: The Mars Volta
pillars.why: The Mars Volta fused progressive ambition with a striking sense of drama and movement.

pillars.name: Fugazi
pillars.why: Fugazi brought a stripped, sharp-edged discipline that fed later guitar-led, rhythm-forward work.
